criteria.observation: The 23 masters share dark steel/charcoal rendering, cool blue/cyan edge light and restrained amber highlights. Cleave and Eagle Eye retain distinct warm focal accents.

The reviewed 800x200 class strips keep all five icons, keys and Russian names visible. Archer F is Eagle Eye; Engineer F is Tactical Nuke. Engineer Q's changing verb is implemented and verified in the game worktree.
At 64 px every silhouette stays inside the slot. Resource materials and ability categories remain distinct without clipping.
At 32 px the primary shapes remain distinct. Bow and turret details are fine but still identify their respective abilities.

gameplay.notes: These are generated art/layout sheets, not Godot captures. Runtime and requested MCP inspection are recorded with the game-side Issue #52 work; no MCP runtime result is claimed for this source-art review.

known_deviations: This static art package does not include Godot runtime screenshots. Its generated layouts are explicitly labeled as non-engine evidence.
